# x402 JSON Flattener

> Deterministic nested JSON → flat path-value map for agents. Supports arrays, deep objects, custom separators. Pay-per-call via x402 (USDC on Base).

## Endpoints

- GET /catalog – free discovery
- GET /api/flatten – service info
- POST /api/flatten – paid flatten

## Pricing

~0.004 – 0.012 USDC per call (default max 0.01 USDC)

## Input

```json
{
  "data": { "nested": { "key": "value", "arr": [1, 2] } },
  "options": {
    "separator": ".",
    "arrayStyle": "index|bracket",
    "maxDepth": 20
  }
}
```

## Output

```json
{
  "success": true,
  "flat": {
    "nested.key": "value",
    "nested.arr.0": 1,
    "nested.arr.1": 2
  },
  "meta": { "keys": 3, "depth": 2 }
}
```

Ideal for autonomous agents preparing data for vector stores, caching keys, or simple key-value stores.
